name: Drag and drop (mouse + touch, pop-up trash can)
description: One pointer drag-and-drop engine for every list, tree, grid, timeline and toolbar of an app: works with a mouse and with a finger (drag from a grip), drop markers before / after / inside, zones that say what they accept, a ghost under the pointer, and a trash can that pops up at the bottom while something deletable is dragged. Harvested Oct 22 2026 from Walkthrough Studio.

parts.label: Drop zones + markers
parts.description: Elements marked data-axf-drop accept drops; the hovered one shows a before / after / inside marker.

parts.label: Touch dragging
parts.description: On a phone a drag starts from a grip (class axf-dnd-grip), so scrolling still works everywhere else.

parts.label: Drag ghost
parts.description: A label with the item's icon follows the pointer.

parts.label: Pop-up trash can
parts.description: While something deletable is dragged, a trash can pops up; dropping on it deletes.

placeholders.note: Compose port (Modifier.dragAndDrop + the same zones) — Android on hold.
Keyboard moves (pick up with Space, arrows, drop with Space) — not built.
